name: BEV Crash 2025-2026 — US Policy-to-Poverty Cascade

trigger.description: 25% US tariff on all vehicle imports (Apr 3) + 25% on components (May 3) combined with EPA emissions rollback and $7,500 EV tax credit elimination, triggering $70B+ in OEM write-downs and global supply chain collapse

context: Three simultaneous US policy shifts created a compounding cascade through the global auto industry: (1) 25% universal tariff on vehicle imports (Apr 3, 2025) extended to components (May 3, 2025), imposing $107.7B in additional costs; (2) EPA rescinded stringent GHG regulations (Feb 2026), removing the regulatory push for BEVs; (3) $7,500 federal EV tax credit eliminated (Oct 2025), killing consumer demand. OEMs booked $70B+ in write-downs: Stellantis $26.3B, Ford $21B, Honda $15.7B, GM $7.6B. European exports to US fell 21.4%. Battery material prices collapsed (lithium -70%, cobalt -40%, nickel -30%), devastating mining communities in Congo, Chile, and Indonesia.
